From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@collarstone.com>, Rajiv Suresh <rajiv@collarstone.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CollarStone: Observability launch kickoff & integration agenda

Hi Ellen / Rajiv —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the CollarStone integration. To keep the launch tight and predictable, I want to get everyone aligned on the first two weeks of work for observability and ops readiness. Attached is a short onboarding workbook (template + initial questions) so your team can populate expected dashboards, signal owners, and SLO targets.

Proposed agenda for the kickoff call (30-45m):
- Introductions & scope (5m)
- Dashboard inventory: required widgets & owners (10m)
- Tracing hooks: SDK placement and sampling & spans mapping (10m)
- Error taxonomy & alert routing (10m)
- Runbook handoff & next actions (5m)

Can you confirm availability for Tue 07 May, 10:00–10:45 PT? If that doesn't work, propose two alternative windows.

Prep requests (please before the call if possible):
- Share a brief list of the top 6 transactions/endpoints you want visibility on (paths or hostnames).
- If you have an existing alert playbook, upload it to the Drive link below.

Attachments: collarstone-onboarding-workbook.xlsx (workbook with tabs: dashboards, traces, alerts, contacts)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-collarstone-observability
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.company/deal/CS-4482

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

— Marissa

Marissa —

Thanks, this looks great. Tue 07 May 10:00 PT works for our PM + platform lead. I uploaded a short list of the endpoints and a one-page alert matrix to the Drive folder (see link in your email).

Quick context so you have it before the call:
- Our top concerns are cold-start latency for inference and a spike in token usage during batch imports.
- We currently instrument traces with OpenTelemetry but sampling is low—Rajiv will outline what we can bump for the pilot.
- Procurement loop: procurement@collarstone.com will require a simple SOC2 evidence doc before Dedicated capacity provisioning; I cc'd them on further billing/contract steps.

See you Tue.

— Ellen

Ellen / team —

Small technical notes ahead of Tue's call so we can be concrete:
- Tracing: for inference stacks we recommend instrumenting the request entry and the model execution span. If you can expose the model variant and prompt size as attributes, that'll help our regression alerts.
- Dashboard templates: I'll bring a proposed set for token-cost, latency P50/P95, and KV cache hit-rate.
- Sampling: bump to 10% for the first 48 hours of the pilot; we'll provide a safe sampler we recommend.

Attaching: redwood-runbook-template.md — fill the incident playbook "who to page" and escalation path columns.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Quick confirmation from infra side:
- I'll own dashboard build and permission setup in the console; Naomi will handle alert routing to your on-call rota.
- For trace enrichment, Rajiv: can you add a request_id header so we can stitch client logs to spans?
- Suggested default alert routing: Severity P0 -> PagerDuty critical channel; P1 -> Slack #collarstone-ops; P2 -> Email to dev on-call. We can tweak during the pilot.
